manual_visual_review: Sixteen partial-border actions compose four meaningful four-unit arm marks, paired source-to-C in two colors. Every marked unit is needed to cover one full arm; there is no arbitrary mark-count limit. Black/white fills and all16 cell patterns in each option remain fully readable. Marks are only outer borders, so no new internal cut partition or piece is implied. The selected top-right C orientation fails while its other placement remains visibly available.
